security_privacy_cost_impact: One migration changes app.performance_snapshots' primary key to (id, metric_time); no row, grant, policy, role or client reach changes, and the table is applied to no instance. Rule 17 now refuses MORE: on the four PROVIDER-3 or INTERNAL-3 tables any client privilege beyond a pinned column read (none today), and on the twelve open tables any client SELECT column not pinned, as well as a pinned one revoked. It revokes nothing: three client-readable columns that read as unsafe or unproven against ERD §9.1 are findings SP-1..SP-3 owed to A1/A6. The harness change alters a query the harness runs, not a client. Cost: the classification probe reads every column of 16 tables for 3 client roles twice; migrate-clean 4.9 s on this host.
migration_and_data_impact: db/foundation/migrations/150_performance_snapshots_key.sql: drop constraint performance_snapshots_pkey; add it as primary key (id, metric_time), under lock_timeout 5s and statement_timeout 60s; comments; an apply-time block. Forward only; 121 is not edited. On an empty table the index build is immediate; with rows it is a full scan under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, which is why it is done now. Declared not applied to the provisioned instance (catalog-snapshot.json tail). No partition by and no index (Q150-b). Number 150: Q150-c's one-time exception to MOD-120's range.
